dishes.name: Bergen op Zoom anchovies
dishes.desc: The only Dutch anchovies, caught by one family in fyke nets off Bergen op Zoom from May to early June and sold fresh or salted.

dishes.name: Bergse puddingkoek
dishes.desc: Large round pudding tart from Bergen op Zoom, also called koeienvlaai. A bakery speciality of West Brabant.

dishes.name: West Brabant white asparagus
dishes.desc: White asparagus grown around Bergen op Zoom, served in spring with ham, egg and butter. Many restaurants run a dedicated asparagus menu.

dishes.name: Chaams hoen
dishes.desc: Free-range chicken from the farms south of Breda, roasted or stewed. A traditional product of the Chaam area.
